Point2.description: A sketch point in mm: [x, y] or {"x", "y"}.

SketchTarget.description: The sketch: its feature id or its name (default: the one being edited).

StringList.description: A name, or a list of names.

input.description:
Make copies of sketch curves and points in a grid, as an associative pattern: one row along
`direction` (or `dir`) and, with `count2`, more rows along `direction2` (or `dir2`). The
copies follow the originals, and the pattern keeps its own constraints. Quantities include the
original, at most 500 copies in all; a negative spacing reverses its direction. With
`pattern`, edit the pattern that id names instead of making a new one: keys left out keep
their values, surviving instance ids are kept, and the pattern's type cannot change. A changed
`entities` list rebuilds every copy with fresh ids. One undo step.

alignment.description:
Where the original stands along the first direction: `left`, `center` or `right`.
Default: right.

alignment2.description: The same along the second direction. Default: right.

count.description:
How many along the first direction, the original included: a whole number from 1 to 500
or a unitless expression. Left out only with `pattern`.

count2.description:
How many along the second direction, a whole number from 1 to 500 or a unitless
expression. Default: 1.

dir.description:
The first direction as a vector [x, y] (finite, not zero; it is normalised). Default:
sketch x.

dir2.description: The second direction as a vector [x, y]. Default: perpendicular to the first.

direction.description: A sketch line the first direction follows (a live reference), by id.

direction2.description: A sketch line the second direction follows (a live reference), by id.

entities.description:
The curves and points to copy, by id (one id is taken as a list of one). Left out only
with `pattern`.

pattern.description: The id of an existing rectangular pattern to edit instead of making a new one.

reversed.description:
Reverse the placement along the first direction, and the extra side of an even total with
`center`. Default: false.

reversed2.description: The same along the second direction. Default: false.

sketch.description: The sketch (default: the one being edited).

spacing.description:
The distance between copies along the first direction, in mm: a number or a length
expression. Left out only with `pattern`.

spacing2.description: The distance between copies along the second direction, in mm. Default: `spacing`.

input.title: RectangularPatternParams

label: Rectangular Pattern

Created.description: What a command added to its sketch: the ids that the sketch has now and did not before.

constraints.description: Constraint ids, dimensions not among them.

wires.description: The ids of 3D curves, when the command made any.

center.description: A circular pattern's centre point id; `null` for a rectangular one.

created.description: Everything the call added to the sketch: `{points, curves, constraints, dimensions}`.

param_warnings.description: In the warn parameter-check mode: what the call's parameters got wrong.

pattern.description: The pattern's id: give it as `pattern` to edit it.

params: entities: [ids], count, spacing; count2?, spacing2?; counts: positive integer numbers or expressions, at most 500 instances total; spacings: length numbers or expressions; direction?, direction2?: sketch line ids (live references); dir?, dir2?: [x,y] vectors (defaults: sketch x, perpendicular to direction 1); alignment?, alignment2?: left|center|right (default right). Signed spacings reverse each direction. reversed?, reversed2?: bool (default false); reverses placement and the extra side of even centered totals. Quantities include the original. Adds associative pattern constraints. Returns pattern id. pattern?: existing pattern id to edit (omitted values retained; surviving instance ids retained). Returns created: {points, curves, constraints, dimensions}: the ids of what it added (stable and never reused: usable right away in sketch.dimension, sketch.constraint.*, sketch.delete…)
